sectionHeading: **The Dragon, and What It Has Always Meant**
authority: Editorial craft owned by the editorial agent under author delegation. Canon, claim scope, and canon-bearing status statements remain author decisions.

ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0006 is decisive in Part VIII: it requires that no physiological measure determine governance standing, and CTD-0005 adds subsistence to the protected list. The shipped bright-line formulation, which names speak, vote, lead, receive subsistence, and hold equal political standing, is stronger than the baseline's and is kept. CTD-0076 requires Scale as the singular and ICONS only as the plural, which changed several restored sentences in the first Scale and dragon chapters. CTD-0030 forbids presenting the Cardinal Scale as existing. CTD-0036 requires the eighty-seven, one hundred and fifty, and five hundred figures to remain distinct with their nesting explained. CTD-0069 governs the use of cultural traditions, which bears on the dragon material. CTD-0081 forbids numerology as evidence and was read. CTD-0012 keeps the Currency of Presence, COHERENCE, and Bio-Consensus distinct.

findings.summary: The cross-cultural observation was reduced to a disclaimer about it.

evidence.baseline: Across a wide range of human cultures, separated by oceans and millennia, a similar figure recurs: a great serpent or dragon, coiled through earth and water and sky, standing for a living intelligence larger than any single creature ... The cultures that imagined this figure were not being naive.
evidence.shipped: The dragon is offered as an image, not a claim of common doctrine across cultures.

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0069 and CTD-0078, applied to cultural attribution.
findings.diagnosis: The shipped disclaimer is required and is kept verbatim. It is a bound on a claim, not a substitute for one, and the pass kept the bound and deleted what it bounded. The observation is restored with the baseline's astonishing range reduced to a wide range, which is the hedge the items ask for without erasing the claim.

findings.summary: The precise point of the metaphor, that Providence is not the dragon, was reduced to one sentence and lost its architecture.

evidence.baseline: Human beings and their cultures are the organs of perception and relationship and action through which the body becomes conscious of itself ... And Providence, this is the precise point of the metaphor, is not the dragon. Providence is the connective tissue through which the Scales might recognize one another. It is the nervous system by which a living planet might begin, at last, to coordinate with itself consciously.
evidence.shipped: Providence is not the dragon. It is the connective tissue through which communities might recognize one another.

findings.diagnosis: The shipped pair keeps the two central clauses and drops the third, the nervous system by which a planet coordinates with itself through sovereign human communities rather than through domination. That third clause is the whole architecture stated in the image, and the card lists the dragon as a bounded image for distributed relation among the signature metaphors.

findings.summary: The card-bound return-to-ground sentence was carried in its pass-authored form, and the record's keep was superseded by the re-prepared card.

evidence.baseline: The metaphor must not be allowed to overpower the architecture, and so we return it to the ground.
evidence.shipped: The metaphor earns its place only while it remains bounded, and so we return it to the ground.

findings.authorizedBy: R-VOICE-BIND under the volume card re-prepared from the baseline on 2026-07-31 (CTD-0110) and approved with quotation provenance ratified in the D1 to D6 ruling session. The original generation kept the pass form because the earlier card, prepared from the shipped text, protected it.
findings.diagnosis: The two sentences do the same work and the difference is the author's to settle, and on 2026-07-31 the author settled it: the re-prepared card lists the baseline sentence both as an exemplar opening anchor and as a protected line, replacing the pass-authored dragon line by name. The keep recorded in this record's generation was correct under the card then in force and is wrong under the card now in force. The baseline sentence is restored. The pass sentence contributed a compact statement of the boundedness condition; that condition survives in the same paragraph, which begins by returning the image to the ground and ends by reducing the dragon to a way of remembering.

debtImpact.note: The shipped disclaimer that the dragon is not a claim of common doctrine is kept and the baseline's astonishing range is hedged to a wide range.
The cultural claim is hedged rather than sourced. The item names this passage and stays open.
The restored image speaks of the Scales as the plates along the body, using the singular term correctly.

generations.label: A
generations.title: Derived from the immutable baseline under the thirteen rules

reasoning.note: R-LEDGER-WINS. Both shipped bounds are kept: no claim of common doctrine across cultures, and the explicit statement that cells are not citizens and organisms are not constitutions.
R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Three em dashes. Two were parenthetical appositives and became comma pairs. One introduced the precise point of the metaphor and became a comma pair.
The card-protected line The metaphor does not excuse the accounting, which the shipped text places in the widening of presence section and which is kept there.
The cross-cultural observation in hedged form, the not being naive sentence, the living body image, the organs of perception, and the nervous system clause.

openQuestions: The baseline label The Dragon, and What It Has Always Meant asserts a constant meaning across cultures, which is precisely what CTD-0069 and CTD-0078 dispute. The current label The Dragon and Its Limits does not, and it holds the route. The rename is an improvement and costs nothing. The labels were not touched.

The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-04 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The section is the clearest case in the volume of a current label being better than its baseline for ledger reasons, which is worth recording precisely because this pass restored so much the prior one removed. The prior pass was right about the label and wrong about the paragraph.

audits.scope: First standardAudit for this record. Full re-read of the current section against the immutable baseline under all twenty rules, run under the baseline-prepared volume card adopted 2026-07-31 (CTD-0110) and after the 2026-07-31 resolution of CTD-0030. The original record was derived under the thirteen-rule index; this audit adds the substitution count and the later rules: R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY, R-CORRECTION-SCOPE, R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD, R-PAIRED-DELETION, R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT, and R-REFRAIN-COST.

substitutionTest.rule: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, substitution form, run as standing procedure before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Normalize both texts, strip markup, split into sentences of three or more words, count baseline sentences appearing verbatim in the current section.
substitutionTest.note: Counted after the restoration below. Well above zero, so the pairing test applies. Every non-surviving baseline sentence was attributed: the em dash repairs, the CTD-0069 hedges recorded in F1, an astonishing range to a wide range and the same figure to a similar figure, with the kept disclaimer not as a claim of common doctrine across cultures, the CTD-0076 conversion of the ICONS-as-scales sentence to the Scales as the plates along the body, the might-recognize modality beside it, and the referent repair The image asks only that we take seriously, forced by the kept cells-are-not-citizens bound standing between the mystical sentence and its baseline pronoun.

audits.checked: R-VOICE-BIND, fired: the 2026-07-31 card binds The metaphor must not be allowed to overpower the architecture both as exemplar anchor and protected line, and the manuscript carried the pass form. Restored; recorded as F3; this section's anchor now clears npm run editorial:voice-exemplars. R-LEDGER-WINS, re-run: CTD-0069 and CTD-0078 remain open queries and the hedged observation with its kept disclaimer still pays them down; CTD-0076 open, the Scales usage stands; CTD-0030 resolved, nothing here reopens it. R-CORRECTION-SCOPE: the restoration changed the one sentence the card names and nothing adjacent; the kept bound sentence and the we-form referent repair that depends on it were left standing. R-PAIRED-DELETION: dragon, serpent, nervous system, connective tissue, and Scales swept two-ended; the closing interlude and Coherence Without Conformity carry the other ends and all stand. R-CAUTIOUS-HALF: heading pair re-confirmed, baseline The Dragon, and What It Has Always Meant against current The Dragon and Its Limits, already adjudicated in this record's open questions as a ledger-aligned improvement; the route holds. R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT: the kept cells-are-not-citizens bound is a ledger-adjacent keep already recorded in the generation notes; no further credit owed. R-REFRAIN-COST, R-TENSE, R-DEIXIS, R-NEGATION-STACK: nothing fires.
audits.conclusion: One firing, real: the return-to-ground sentence restored to its baseline form under the re-prepared card, a ten-word-for-ten-word replacement. Nine of fifteen baseline sentences now survive verbatim, the rest attributed. The regeneration conclusion is amended by F3: the prior pass was right about the label and wrong about the paragraph, and it was also wrong about this sentence once the card was re-derived from the baseline.
